column3: soft-cycle example: lattice.py cycles() walks a Python set of successor ids, so the example it prints follows string-hash order (PYTHONHASHSEED=0); the port walks successors in catalog order. Asserted: same pack, same kind (soft), a closed cycle over optional-inclusive edges of activities that pack selected
